gaps.formal_rule: Service at the published interval for the asset class.
gaps.actual_practice: Experienced planners bring the window forward when load has been trending up and the last reading is stale.
gaps.why_they_differ: The interval assumes stable load. The override is the judgment that keeps it safe when load is not stable.

gaps.actual_practice: The planner calls the regional operator before raising a formal deferral.
gaps.why_they_differ: The informal call is what makes the formal step succeed.
